title: Appraisal Order Complexity Add-On Occupancy Schedule
content:
**Occupancy schedule — Appraisal Order complexity add-on.**

The occupancy part of the complexity add-on reads the occupancy of the Mortgage Loan File the order supports: an investment property adds 90 dollars, a second home adds 60 dollars, and a primary residence adds nothing. The occupancy part is added into the add-on subtotal of the complexity add-on.

| Occupancy on the Mortgage Loan File | Adds (USD) |
|---|---|
| Investment property | 90.00 |
| Second home | 60.00 |
| Primary residence | 0.00 |

*Hypothetical cases.* A file recorded as a second home: the occupancy part is 60.00. The same property on a file recorded as an investment property: 90.00. On a file recorded as a primary residence: nothing.
